crossRefs.note: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until…
Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink…
and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his…
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and…
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts…
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.

translations.web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
translations.bsb: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
translations.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
translations.asv: Be not among winebibbers, Among gluttonous eaters of flesh:
